purposeStrings.NSCameraUsageDescription: Plethora uses the camera only when you scan a sync QR code to link another device. No photos or video are recorded or uploaded.
purposeStrings.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Plethora uses the microphone only when you record pronunciation practice or dictate a note. Recordings stay on your device unless you explicitly choose cloud transcription, which is disclosed before first use.
